# Heatmap News: Ecolab Featured at Heatmap House During Climate Week NYC


November 2, 2026


The U.S. is in the middle of an industrial buildout — and the energy system is at the center of it. At Heatmap House’s “America’s Great Reindustrialization” event in NYC, Ecolab Senior Vice President and Chief Sustainability Officer Emilio Tenuta joined Heatmap CEO and Editor-in-Chief Nico Lauricella for a fireside chat on one of the less visible constraints facing the AI infrastructure boom: water.


Watch the conversation below.
